asleep.description: Whether this pet's species is inside one of its published sleep windows right now, in which case createInteraction refuses a feed or a pet with the "asleep" code. Reported for the same reason the cooldown fields are: so the client disables the button on the real rule rather than on a copy it keeps itself and discovers is wrong by being refused.

feedCooldownRemaining.description: Seconds until this pet can be fed again, or 0 if it can be now. Reported so the client can show a countdown and disable the button on the real rule, rather than on a copy of the cooldown it keeps itself and discovers is wrong by being refused.

interactionCooldown.description: The full cooldown length in seconds, from pet.trezy.gameConfig. Lets a client start a countdown the instant it acts, without waiting a round trip and without hardcoding the number.

petCooldownRemaining.description: Seconds until this pet can be petted again, or 0 if it can be now.

wakesAt.description: The GAME HOUR this pet wakes, absent when it is awake. ⚠ A GAME HOUR AND NOT A TIMESTAMP: a client wanting a countdown has dayLengthSeconds and can do the arithmetic, while an instant would be a second encoding of the same fact and the two could disagree.
